title: HSBC named as the World’s Best Transaction Bank in Euromoney awards | HSBC news | HSBC Holdings plc
summary: World’s Best Transaction Bank award demonstrates our progress in building a more connected, client-led and internationally differentiated transaction bank.
body_markdown:
We’ve been named as the World’s Best Transaction Bank in Euromoney’s Transaction Banking Awards 2026.


This demonstrates the progress we’re making in building a more connected, client-led and internationally differentiated transaction bank.


It also reflects the focus we’re putting on delivering best-in-class experiences – from trade finance and cash management to innovating for the future.


In its awards coverage, Euromoney said: “HSBC’s achievement in 2025 was not defined by a single product innovation or an exceptional performance in one market. What distinguished the bank was the breadth of its progress across transaction banking.


“From payments, liquidity management to trade finance, working capital and foreign exchange, HSBC invested in strengthening virtually every part of its franchise, across all type of clients it serves, from international mid-market to large corporates and institutional clients.


“Few banks can demonstrate that consistency of investment and execution across such a broad international business.”


[Find out more on the Euromoney website (opens in new window)](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/www.euromoney.com/article/6sycjkt53sgs0oggoscg0ccw/corporate-banking/the-worlds-best-transaction-bank-2026-hsbc/__;!!LSAcJDlP!yBeYYAjsn8x79b1MeWtVI-S9vR4rhFwV9stTvMLnTy2wavN2_RvR-otvR2SLVMFD3KPESmQW2jVa_7Qp4q4yb9LinFgXew$) .


## Our other award wins


As well as the global award, we were named as Asia’s Best Transaction Bank and the Middle East’s Best Cash Management Bank.


In addition, we also won Best Transaction Bank in our home markets of Hong Kong and the UK, with further recognition across 13 other markets (see below) and five standout client deals.


The Euromoney Transaction Banking Awards recognise excellence across cash management, payments and trade finance.


They evaluate market leaders across global, regional, and country specific categories, identifying those that are driving transformation and delivering outstanding value to clients.


Winners are selected through research, data analysis, peer benchmarking, and direct engagement with market participants.


Our full list of market awards:


- **Best Transaction Bank:** Australia & New Zealand, Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Korea, Philippines, Sri Lanka, Thailand, UK
- **Most Innovative Transaction Bank:** Singapore
- **Best Trade Finance Bank:** India, Indonesia, Mexico
- **Best Corporate Payments Bank:** Japan
- **Best Cash Management Bank:** US
